audit_items.title: Verify Cryptographic Hash Collision Resistance: Is keccak256 in encode_account implementation using a vetted library with no known weaknesses?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: encode_account is an EL (Execution Layer) function. Prysm is a CL (Consensus Layer) client. The keccak256 in prysm uses golang.org/x/crypto/sha3.NewLegacyKeccak256() which is a vetted library, but encode_account does not exist in this codebase.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is receipt decoding via decode_receipt in parse_deposit_requests producing identical log lists across all EL implementations?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: decode_receipt and parse_deposit_requests are EL functions. Prysm is a CL client that receives already-processed deposit data via Engine API, not raw receipts.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are receipt_keys in parse_deposit_requests iterated in canonical RLP-encoded transaction index order across all EL implementations?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: parse_deposit_requests is an EL function that iterates receipt_keys. Prysm (CL) does not implement this - it receives deposit data via Engine API from the EL.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is chain_id value of 0 in EIP-7702 Authorization handled consistently as a wildcard across all EL clients?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EIP-7702 Authorization is an EL transaction type validation. Prysm (CL) does not validate EL transaction internals - it only sees opaque transaction bytes in ExecutionPayload.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is Authorization.address validated as exactly 20 bytes before signature verification?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: Authorization.address validation is EL transaction validation. Prysm (CL) does not parse or validate EL transaction internals.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is Authorization.y_parity validated to be exactly 0 or 1, rejecting all other values?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: Authorization.y_parity validation is EL transaction validation. Prysm (CL) does not parse or validate EL transaction internals.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are Authorization.r and Authorization.s validated as valid secp256k1 scalars, rejecting r=0 or s=0?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: Authorization signature validation is EL transaction validation. Prysm (CL) does not parse or validate EL transaction internals.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is the EL requests hash computed identically across all EL implementations for the same block?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL requests hash computation is performed by EL clients. Prysm (CL) receives the requests_hash via Engine API and uses it directly without recomputation.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does extract_deposit_data produce identical output bytes across all EL implementations for the same log data?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: extract_deposit_data is an EL function that parses deposit logs. Prysm (CL) does not extract deposit data from logs - it receives processed deposit data via Engine API.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does parse_deposit_requests handle receipts with zero logs gracefully without errors?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: parse_deposit_requests is an EL function. Prysm (CL) does not parse receipts - it receives deposit requests via Engine API.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are unknown transaction types rejected with TransactionTypeError before any other validation?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: Transaction type validation is EL functionality. Prysm (CL) does not validate EL transaction types - transactions are opaque bytes in ExecutionPayload.

audit_items.title: Verify Validation Ordering: Are transaction validation checks mutually exclusive and ordered general-to-specific?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: Transaction validation ordering is EL functionality. Prysm (CL) does not validate EL transactions.

audit_items.title: Verify Complete Validation: Can any code path skip a required validation check?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: Transaction validation completeness is EL functionality. Prysm (CL) does not implement transaction validation.

audit_items.title: Verify Blob Transaction Validation: Are all blob-specific checks applied in correct order?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: Blob transaction validation (versioned hash checks, MAX_BLOB_COUNT) is EL functionality. Prysm (CL) validates blob sidecars separately but not EL blob transaction rules.

audit_items.title: Verify Block Size Limit: Are blocks exceeding MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE rejected before processing?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE enforcement is EL block validation. Prysm (CL) receives ExecutionPayload via Engine API, not raw RLP blocks.

audit_items.title: Verify Post-Merge Block Constraints: Are blocks with non-empty ommers rejected?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: Ommer validation is EL block validation. Prysm (CL) does not validate EL block ommers - this is enforced by the EL.

audit_items.title: Verify Computed Roots Match Header: Do all 8 computed roots/hashes match header values exactly?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: Root/hash verification (transactions_root, state_root, receipt_root, etc.) is EL block validation. Prysm (CL) trusts these values from the EL via Engine API.

audit_items.title: Verify Base Fee Calculation: Is base fee increase bounded and never zero when gas exceeds target?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: Base fee calculation (EIP-1559) is EL functionality. Prysm (CL) does not validate or compute base fees.

audit_items.title: Verify Gas Limit Constraints: Is gas limit change bounded within 1/1024 per block?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: Gas limit bounds validation is EL block validation. Prysm (CL) does not enforce EL gas limit rules.

audit_items.title: Verify Header Field Constraints: Are all header invariants (number, timestamp, difficulty, nonce, etc.) validated?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EL header field validation (number, timestamp, difficulty, nonce) is EL functionality. Prysm (CL) validates CL-specific fields only.

audit_items.title: Verify Transaction Gas and Fee Checks: Are gas/blob gas limits and fee relationships validated?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: Transaction gas and fee validation is EL functionality. Prysm (CL) does not validate EL transaction gas or fees.

audit_items.title: Verify Nonce and Balance Checks: Are sender nonce and balance validated before execution?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: Nonce and balance validation is EL state transition functionality. Prysm (CL) does not have access to EL account state.

audit_items.title: Verify System Transaction Invariants: Do system transactions use SYSTEM_ADDRESS and fixed gas?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: System transaction invariants (SYSTEM_ADDRESS, SYSTEM_TRANSACTION_GAS) are EL implementation details. Prysm (CL) does not invoke or validate system transactions.

audit_items.title: Verify Block Body Processing Order: Is the processing order strictly maintained?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: Block body processing order (beacon roots -> history storage -> user txs -> withdrawals -> requests) is EL apply_body functionality. Prysm (CL) does not control EL block processing order.

audit_items.title: Verify Request Ordering: Are requests appended in ascending type order (0, 1, 2)?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: Request ordering (deposits type 0, withdrawals type 1, consolidations type 2) is EL functionality. Prysm (CL) receives requests via Engine API without reordering.

audit_items.title: Verify Gas Refund Calculations: Is refund capped at gas_used // 5 and EIP-7623 floor applied?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: Gas refund calculations (EIP-3529, EIP-7623) are EL EVM execution functionality. Prysm (CL) does not perform EVM execution.

audit_items.title: Verify Nonce Increment Timing: Is nonce incremented before message execution?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: Nonce increment timing is EL EVM execution detail. Prysm (CL) does not perform EVM execution or manage EL account nonces.

audit_items.title: Verify Withdrawal Amount Scaling: Are withdrawal amounts correctly scaled from Gwei to Wei?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: Withdrawal amount scaling (Gwei to Wei) is performed by the EL when processing withdrawals. Prysm (CL) provides withdrawal amounts in Gwei via Engine API.

audit_items.title: Verify p256verify Precompile: Does it never revert except for out-of-gas?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: p256verify precompile is EL EVM precompile functionality. Prysm (CL) does not implement EVM precompiles.

audit_items.title: Verify Data Column Sidecar Gossip Validation: Is the 13-step validation pipeline complete?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: This check references EL spec validation steps. Prysm implements CL-side data column sidecar validation in beacon-chain/sync but with CL-specific validation rules, not the referenced 13-step EL pipeline.

audit_items.title: Verify GAS_CAP Enforcement: Is the 16777216 (2^24) gas cap enforced at txpool and block validation?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: GAS_CAP enforcement at txpool and block validation is EL functionality. Prysm (CL) does not manage txpool or validate EL transaction gas limits.

audit_items.title: Verify ModExp Gas Formula (EIP-7883): Is the updated formula applied consistently?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: ModExp precompile gas formula is EL EVM functionality. Prysm (CL) does not implement EVM precompiles or gas calculations.

audit_items.title: Verify Deposit Request Parsing: Are DEPOSIT_CONTRACT_ADDRESS and DEPOSIT_EVENT_SIGNATURE_HASH filters applied?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: Deposit request parsing from logs using DEPOSIT_CONTRACT_ADDRESS is EL functionality (Electra). Prysm (CL) has legacy deposit log processing in beacon-chain/execution/log_processing.go for pre-Electra, but Electra deposit requests come via Engine API from EL.

audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: RLP encoding for accounts/receipts is EL functionality. Prysm (CL) uses SSZ encoding for CL data structures, not RLP for EL data.

audit_items.title: Verify EIP-7702 Authorization Validation: Are chain_id, nonce, and sender validated?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: EIP-7702 SetCode transaction validation is EL functionality. Prysm (CL) does not parse or validate EL transaction internals.

audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: requests_hash computation using SHA-256 is EL functionality. Prysm (CL) receives the computed requests_hash via Engine API without recomputing it.
